Hi Tim —

Thanks for taking the call with us. Wanted to propose a short working session next week to walk the SIG/SOC2 questionnaire and map evidence owners. We typically do a 30–45 min intake: high-level scope, data flows, any hosted/private deployment specifics, and then we assign evidence owners.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 09/08 10:00–10:45
- Wed 09/09 13:00–13:45

Agenda draft:
1) Introductions + scope (5m)
2) Questionnaire scope and target reports (10m)
3) Evidence map and owners (15m)
4) Next steps + timeline (10m)

Prep: if you can share the questionnaire file and any environment/network diagrams beforehand that would help — we can pre-fill the trivial answers and focus the call on ambiguous items. I attached a short evidence matrix template we use.

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, procurement@clearbluehealth.com
Date: 2026-09-09T13:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearBlue SOC2 intake — quick sync and docs request

Tim / Anna / team —

Great working session — notes and immediate answers below (I kept this focused so your procurement folks can also review). If anything needs clarification I can expand into the full evidence map.

Meeting summary (09/09/2026):
- Scope: ClearBlue will consume Redwood hosted inference API for telemetry enrichment; no on-prem/private deployment required at present. PHI-adjacent telemetry will be pseudonymized prior to send.
- Target report: SOC2 Type II covering security and availability is what you requested; we noted need for encryption at rest + detailed logging for access to customer data.

Immediate answers to flagged items:
1) Data retention and logs:
   - API request logs (metadata only) are retained 90 days by default in the hosted offering; longer retention is available via an add-on (we provide 1yr, 3yr options).
   - Customer artifacts (e.g., uploaded prompt corpora) are stored in your tenant with AES-256 at rest; region defaults to us-west-2 unless you select a different region.

2) Evidence ownership & contacts:
   - Redwood: Soojin Lee (Security Compliance Engineer) will be the primary evidence liaison for SOC2 artifacts, supported by Marissa Cole (Customer Success) for operational access and invoice/timing questions.
   - ClearBlue: Tim and Anna will be the points for validation and internal distribution.

Action items (owner — due):
- Redwood to produce preliminary evidence map (we will pre-fill answers from your questionnaire and mark items needing a screenshot or system export) — Owner: Soojin Lee — Due: 2026-09-11
- ClearBlue to confirm required retention window for logs and provide any closed-list of IP ranges for allowlisting — Owner: Tim Cole — Due: 2026-09-10
- Procurement to share a preferred contract start date and PO template — Owner: procurement@clearbluehealth.com — Due: 2026-09-13

Attachments sent after this email: redwood_evidence_map_v1.pdf (preliminary), redwood_vpn_arch_diagram.png

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the pre-filled evidence map tomorrow.

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
